label: v6 Ironwood transfer
why: Version 6 transaction (ZIP 229) with 1 Ironwood action and 2 transparent inputs; tools written before NU6.3 show transfers like this as 0.0 ZEC (lifinance/data-types #281).

label: Ironwood migration transfer
why: Version 6 transaction with 2 Orchard actions and 1 Ironwood action moving exactly 10 ZEC across the turnstile with the canonical fee and rolling expiry: the ZIP 318 transfer shape that blends in with every other migration.

label: Migration with an odd amount
why: Same 2 Orchard to 1 Ironwood shape, but 0.09775 ZEC crosses, which is not a {1,2,5}×10^k denomination, so ZIP 318 classifies it as nonconforming and the amount alone can single it out.

label: Orchard and Ironwood in one transaction
why: Version 6 transaction with 2 Orchard actions and 1 Ironwood action, the shape a move from Orchard to Ironwood takes; from NU6.3 value may leave Orchard but not enter it, so valueBalanceOrchard must be zero or positive (ZIP 258).

label: Orchard after NU6.3
why: Version 6 transaction with 2 Orchard actions and 1 transparent output; after NU6.3 Orchard may only send value out through the turnstile, never receive new value.

label: Sapling shielded transfer
why: Version 6 transaction that only uses the Sapling pool (1 spend, 2 outputs); amounts and addresses stay encrypted, only nullifiers, commitments and the value balance are public.

label: Transparent only
why: Version 4 transaction with 1 transparent input and 1 output and no shielded data; the fee needs the spent output values, which the inspector fetches as prevouts.

label: Coinbase
why: Version 5 coinbase transaction with 2 transparent outputs; it has no real inputs, and from NU6.3 it must not contain Orchard actions.

label: v5 Sapling before Ironwood
why: Version 5 Sapling transaction (ZIP 225) from the last blocks of NU6.2, branch ID 0x5437f330; 1 spend, 2 outputs. Checking it at a height after 3,428,143 shows why a branch ID must match the upgrade.

label: v5 Orchard before Ironwood
why: Version 5 transaction with 2 Orchard actions from the last blocks of NU6.2 (branch ID 0x5437f330), mined just before NU6.3; compare its Orchard rules with the post-NU6.3 Orchard sample.

label: Testnet after NU7
why: Version 6 testnet transaction mined after NU7 activated at 4,465,026, so it carries branch ID 0x77190ad9 (ZIP 259); pools used: ironwood.
